41973.shortPlayName: The Dragon God Wakes for His Daughter
41973.summary:
The mightiest Dragon God, Vaelor ruled the skies. To keep his daughter Arya from the dragon bloodline's conflicts, he gave up his power and hid as a humble blacksmith.
Arya was all he had after his wife died. Trusting a royal family he had saved, he gave her to them—who destroyed her. Crown Prince Cassian abused her as a mere vessel of the dragon bloodline.
Fearing her father would destroy the kingdom, Arya hid her pain with a smile; seeing her injuries, he restrained his rage.
Until her wedding day, when he arrived to see those she trusted push her to despair. Discovering her dragon blood, Cassian tried to steal her power; cornered, Arya fell from the tower, awakening her dragon blood in death. He found only her body—and the Dragon God returned.
They had killed not an ordinary girl but a god's only daughter. He vowed to make them pay and reclaim his gift to humanity—yet he wanted more: his daughter back. Redemption teaches him true power lies in protecting those he loves.

41966.shortPlayName: My Beggar Fiancé Is the Billionaire Wolf King
41966.summary: Dumped by her fiancé and pushed into marrying a filthy beggar at her coming-of-age ball, the Earl heiress Ella accepts her fate and says yes. But when her new husband summons armored knights and mountain-high gold, revealing his identity as the powerful Wolf King of the North, her betrayers learn the true price of their greed.

41931.summary: After his family is massacred, Duan Xunchu wrongly believes his sister-in-law Lin Wenyu is the daughter of his enemy. Leaving full of hatred, he returns years later as a young warlord general to take revenge. Torn between family feuds, the two clash and misunderstand each other again and again — yet in the constant push-and-pull, feelings quietly grow. When the misunderstanding is finally cleared, they join hands and walk toward the future together.

41874.summary: Codenamed "Apex," legendary marksman Kim and the Kaiju Caesar fought side by side, becoming heroes who protected humanity's cities from the devastation of mutant creatures. But after his wife was killed by one of the Kaiju, Kim swore never to pick up a gun or be drawn into another war. Hiding his true identity, he lives as a humble janitor, devoted only to protecting his daughter. When mutant creatures suddenly attack her school, disaster strikes. With humanity on the brink once again, the legendary marksman is about to return!

41585.shortPlayName: The Vampire King I Was Born To Kill
41585.summary:
Five centuries ago, humanity forged an eternal pact with vampires, creating three forces: the Bloodline Crown, the Dawn Guardians, the Hunters. The Council imprisoned them. Ava Bennett, the last Guardian, storms the palace to kill King Damon Black.

Damon knew her yet offers a deal: stay and learn the truth about him. He is no monster but the Council's 300-year prisoner on a hated throne. Enemies become allies.

Hunter Ryan Cole tracks them, questioning his mission; Lucius's rebellion unites the trio, and Damon dissolves the pact, toppling Lucius.

Victory is brief: Lucius sacrifices himself to the Eternal Night, unleashing war. Damon is corrupted; Ava seals it with her Dawn Eye, losing her sight. Lucius's last humanity closes the breach.

Ava amends the pact; Ryan guards the door. A year later the artifact restores her Eye, revealing beyond the door an ancient consciousness older than vampires or humans. She opens it, sees a beautiful world, but Damon is gone—so she closes it.

41576.shortPlayName: Rose Shadow War Gardener Helps Me Rise in High Society
41576.summary: Betrayed by her fiancé and his lover, wealthy heiress Chloe loses all her family’s assets overnight. Leo, a powerful avenger disguised as a gardener, comes to her aid. The two form an alliance to gather evidence, fight against the ruthless capital tycoon through high‑stakes power struggles and life‑threatening dangers, exact their revenge, achieve mutual redemption, and gain a mutually devoted love.

36184.shortPlayName: The Priest Is Actually A Seraph
36184.summary: Michael Ashbourne carries the locked power of Seraph Michael. He works as a lowly errand boy priest in a faraway small church. He feels worthless and thinks he has no Holy Light talent at all. He holds a worn-out cracked old oak staff — which is actually the Dawn Holy Staff hiding the Seraph's true form — and steps onto the church's holy trial path. After being humiliated again and again by rich young nobles, he suddenly wakes up a huge, god-like Holy Light. He rises from rock bottom and makes an undying legend. After his sacred blood awakens, he sweeps through all Abyss monsters and church enemies, then steps onto light and heads for Heaven.

41542.shortPlayName: The Mechanic Is the Beast King
41542.summary: Mechanic Kade and his veterinarian wife Lena have always kept their supernatural powers hidden, simply wanting to live an ordinary life with their daughter Ella. But mirror assassins keep attacking them through glass, phones, and reflections, while a secret organization kidnaps Ella, seeking to seize the couple's powers. To save their daughter, they reveal their true identities, transforming into Thunder Griffin and Frost Silver Wolf, storming the enemy base and joining forces with Ella from within to destroy ARK.
